headline: Nebius beats with $981M in sales and doubles its run-rate to $6.4B, stock up ~5% premarket; Brookfield's penny beat; Franco-Nevada and Vylor last night; Cisco, Applied Materials and Cerebras tonight
top_call: Nebius grew revenue 571% to $980.8 million vs $916.8 million expected (Zacks), lost just $0.13 a share vs $0.61 feared, and more than doubled its annualized run-rate to $6.4 billion in three months. The catch: 2026 revenue now lands at the low end of its range and the December ARR target slides to February. The stock is up about 5% before the bell anyway. Plus Brookfield, Franco-Nevada, Vylor and Corteva, explained, and Cisco, Applied Materials and Cerebras tonight.
subject: The Daily Five — Thu Nov 12: Nebius beats ($981M vs $917M), run-rate doubles to $6.4B
backdrop: Wednesday the S&P 500 rose 1.31% to 7,619.38 and the Nasdaq 1.60%. This morning S&P 500 futures are down about 0.4% and Nasdaq-100 futures about 0.8% as Nvidia slides on reports its board is weighing CEO Jensen Huang's future.
on_deck_sub: Reporting after the close today, Nov 12, with Wall Street's EPS estimates

ai.headline: Nvidia's board met overnight on whether to oust CEO Jensen Huang after a second reported affair; no decision yet, and the stock is down about 5-7% premarket
ai.why: Bernstein cut its target to $200 from $400 and Baird to $200 from $500. The world's most important AI company is now a key-man question, and Elon Musk says hiring Huang would be 'an honor.' Popcorn is not financial advice.

ai.headline: CoreWeave is giving back about 7% premarket after Wednesday's 24% earnings pop, while Nebius rises on its own beat
ai.why: The neoclouds trade like one stock until earnings day, then they trade like siblings fighting over the remote.

ai.headline: Mississippi's new Democratic senator-elect Scott Colom pledged to push for a pause on new data center construction until companies pay for their own power and water
ai.why: Democrats now hold at least 55 Senate seats. Data center politics just went national, and AI's power bill has a lobby now.
